Name: Haley Dog Girl - Town NPC
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#ffff00][u][center]Haley Dog Girl[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]


[size=3]This mod changes Haley's appearance by giving her floppy dog ears and tail. She will have them at all times, from the dances to the wedding![/size]
[size=3](The mod does not include a modified portrait, whoever wishes to do so is totally free to do so. No credits needed).[/size]
[b][color=#00ff00][size=4][i]Compatible with most mods that change Haley's appearance, such as Seasonal Outfits.
[/i][/size][/color][/b][b][i][color=#ffff00][size=4]Two versions available.[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[size=3]

[/size][size=4][b][i]Nothing else to add, download the mod, unzip it and move it to the Mods folder of the game.[/i][/b][/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: Unzip in Mods Folder. Endorse Baby!
